title: These are great! Everybody loved them!
text: These are great! Everybody loved them!. I have to say these were a hit at my hawaiian themed party I would buy them again they were so lovely and I filled them up with candy and other things. They looked so cute but it took me a while to get the hang of it (how to put them together) Overall great cute pretty boxes! I definitely would buy again!
